svg.title: Meridian Retail Group — Figure 5 — Security zones and the personal-data flow
svg.text: separate the identifier from the behaviour
Security zones and the personal-data flow

where personal data enters, where the identifier is separated from the behaviour, who may re-join them, what crosses a border, and how an erasure request is executed and evidenced (§7.1–7.4, §7.6 · D-13, D-14)
WHERE PERSONAL DATA IS — and where, by construction, it is not
D-13 · pseudonymisation at the bronze-to-silver boundary, not at the consumption layer
SILVER · the identifier is separated from the behaviour
Unmasking is a group, with an expiry
RIGHT TO ERASURE — a pipeline, not a ticket
Delete at the source layer first
erasure executed within 14 days · physical removal complete within 21 days · regulatory limit: one month
the gap between 14 and 21 days is the retention threshold — explain it to the DPO up front, rather than have it discovered during an audit
§7.1 · THE OBLIGATION LANDSCAPE — and what each one does to the architecture
consent state is a join condition, not a late filter
immutable as-reported history, evidenced lineage, SoD
extended bronze retention, tamper-evident evidence trail
keep it OUT of scope — tokenise or drop at the boundary
redistribution limits as grants and share exclusions
managed storage per regional metastore — EU data in EU storage
regional workspaces; jobs on EU-resident data run in the EU workspace
a global view is built from aggregated or pseudonymised regional
products shared cross-region — never from raw personal data
the data_residency tag drives an ABAC row filter keyed on the
analyst's regional group — a cross-region query returns only
permitted rows rather than failing opaquely
audit system tables record who read what, from where
§7.7 · WHAT AN AUDITOR ASKS, AND WHERE THE ANSWER COMES FROM
Who accessed personal data, and when?
audit system table on the restricted schema
Was this control in place on 3 March?
policy definitions in Git + deployment history
erasure control table + the executing job's audit trail
audit table, Unity Catalog service events
Was the reported number altered after?
append-only finance silver with restatement flags
D-13: separating identifiers at the boundary means most of the estate simply does not contain personal data — a cheaper conversation with the DPO, and a much more targeted erasure.
